meta.title: India GCC Intelligence & Tracker
meta.description: Comprehensive, source-backed tracking of Global Capability Centre openings, expansions, and talent commitments across India.
meta.pipelineSchedule: Refreshed twice daily at 06:00 & 18:00 UTC via automated GitHub Actions
meta.disclaimer: Data is systematically compiled from official corporate disclosures, stock exchange filings (NSE/BSE/SEC), and verified business reporting. Stated job numbers represent public hiring targets and commitments disclosed by corporate leadership.
